name: Egg Fried Rice
description: Quick pan-fried rice with scrambled egg and soy sauce. Best with day-old rice.
steps: Heat oil in a pan and saute minced garlic until fragrant.
Push the garlic aside, scramble the eggs, then break them into small pieces.
Add the cooked rice and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, toss well, and top with sliced green onion.

name: Garlic Fried Rice (Sinangag)
description: Filipino breakfast rice fried with plenty of toasted garlic.
steps: Fry minced garlic in oil over low heat until golden. Set half aside.
Add the cooked rice and break up any clumps.
Season with salt and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Top with the reserved toasted garlic.
image_credit: Photo: Bing Ramos from Quezon City, Philippines (CC BY 2.0)

name: Chicken Adobo
description: Chicken braised in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and bay leaf.
steps: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce and crushed garlic for 15 minutes.
Brown the chicken in a pot with a little oil.
Add the marinade, vinegar, bay leaves and peppercorns. Do not stir until it boils.
Simmer covered for 30 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Uncover and reduce the sauce to your liking.

name: Pork Adobo
description: Tender pork simmered in soy sauce, vinegar and garlic until glossy.
steps: Cut the pork into cubes and marinate in soy sauce and garlic for 15 minutes.
Sear the pork in a pot until lightly browned.
Add the marinade, vinegar, bay leaves, peppercorns and a cup of water.
Simmer covered for 45 minutes until tender.
Uncover and cook until the sauce thickens.

name: Chicken Tinola
description: Light ginger chicken soup with papaya.
steps: Saute garlic, onion and sliced ginger in a pot.
Add the chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Season with fish sauce, add water to cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add sliced papaya and cook until tender.
image_credit: Photo: FoxLad at English Wikipedia (CC BY 3.0)

name: Pork Sinigang
description: Sour tamarind soup with pork and vegetables.
steps: Boil the pork with onion and tomato for 40 minutes until tender.
Add the tamarind (or tamarind soup mix) and sliced radish. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add string beans and cook for 3 minutes.
Add kangkong, turn off the heat, and season with salt or fish sauce.

name: Ginisang Monggo
description: Comforting mung bean stew with pork and greens.
steps: Boil the mung beans in water until soft, about 30 minutes.
In another pot, saute garlic, onion and tomato, then add sliced pork and brown it.
Pour in the cooked mung beans and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and season with salt.

name: Tortang Talong
description: Grilled eggplant dipped in egg and pan-fried into an omelette.
steps: Grill or broil the eggplants until the skin is charred and the flesh is soft.
Peel the eggplants and flatten them with a fork, keeping the stem.
Beat the eggs with minced garlic and a pinch of salt.
Dip each eggplant in the egg and pan-fry until golden on both sides.

name: Pancit Canton
description: Stir-fried egg noodles with chicken and vegetables.
steps: Saute garlic and onion, then add sliced chicken and cook through.
Add sliced carrot and cabbage and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce and a cup of water and bring to a boil.
Add the noodles and toss until they absorb the liquid.

name: Bistek Tagalog
description: Thin beef slices in a tangy soy-calamansi sauce with onion rings.
steps: Marinate thin beef slices in soy sauce, calamansi juice and garlic for 30 minutes.
Fry onion rings until slightly soft, then set aside.
Sear the beef in batches over high heat.
Add the marinade and simmer briefly, then top with the onion rings.

name: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: Tender beef strips with crisp vegetables in a savory sauce.
steps: Slice the beef thinly and toss with a little soy sauce.
Sear the beef over high heat, then set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, onion, carrot and bell pepper for 3 minutes.
Return the beef, add the remaining soy sauce, and toss.

name: Chicken Curry
description: Mild, creamy chicken curry with potato and carrot.
steps: Saute garlic and onion, then add the chicken and brown it.
Stir in curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, potato and carrot.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the vegetables are tender. Season with salt.

name: Chicken Sopas
description: Creamy Filipino chicken macaroni soup.
steps: Saute garlic and onion, add the chicken and cook until no longer pink.
Add water and simmer for 15 minutes. Shred the chicken.
Add the macaroni and carrot and cook until the pasta is soft.
Stir in cabbage and milk, heat through, and season.

name: Crispy Fried Chicken
description: Simple home-style fried chicken with a crunchy coating.
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and minced garlic.
Dip each piece in beaten egg, then coat well in flour.
Deep-fry in hot oil for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels before serving.

name: Pan-Fried Fish with Tomato
description: Crispy fish topped with a quick garlic, onion and tomato sauce.
steps: Season the fish with salt and pan-fry until crisp on both sides. Set aside.
In the same pan, saute garlic, onion and chopped tomato until soft.
Add a splash of water and simmer for 2 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over the fish.

name: Tomato Omelette
description: Fluffy omelette with fresh tomato and onion.
steps: Dice the tomato and onion.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Saute the onion, add the tomato, then pour in the eggs.
Cook until set, fold, and serve.

name: Creamy Scrambled Eggs
description: Soft, creamy eggs cooked low and slow.
steps: Whisk the eggs with a splash of milk and a pinch of salt.
Melt butter in a pan over low heat.
Add the eggs and stir slowly until just set.
Take off the heat while still slightly glossy.

name: French Toast
description: Bread soaked in sweet egg custard and fried in butter.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk and sugar in a shallow bowl.
Soak each slice of bread for a few seconds on each side.
Fry in butter over medium heat until golden on both sides.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: Golden, buttery toast with melted cheese.
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Place cheese between the unbuttered sides.
Cook in a pan over medium-low heat until golden, then flip and repeat.

name: Tuna Sandwich
description: Classic tuna salad with onion between soft bread.
steps: Drain the tuna and flake it into a bowl.
Mix with mayonnaise, finely chopped onion, salt and pepper.
Spread between slices of bread.

name: Banana Pancakes
description: Soft pancakes sweetened with ripe banana.
steps: Mash the banana and whisk in the egg and milk.
Stir in the flour and sugar until just combined.
Cook ladlefuls on a greased pan until bubbles form, then flip.

name: Banana Oatmeal
description: Warm oats cooked in milk and topped with banana and honey.
steps: Simmer the oats in milk for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Slice the banana on top.
Drizzle with honey.

name: Garlic Butter Pasta
description: Simple pasta tossed in garlic butter and cheese.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente. Save a cup of the water.
Melt butter in a pan and gently cook sliced garlic.
Toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water.
Finish with grated cheese.

name: Tomato Garlic Pasta
description: Pasta in a fresh tomato, garlic and onion sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Saute garlic and onion, then add chopped tomatoes.
Simmer for 15 minutes until saucy. Season with salt and pepper.
Toss with the pasta and top with cheese.

name: Creamy Potato Soup
description: Comforting soup of potato, onion and milk.
steps: Melt butter and soften the onion and garlic.
Add diced potatoes and enough water to cover.
Simmer until the potatoes are soft, about 20 minutes.
Mash or blend, stir in the milk, and season.

name: Mashed Potatoes
description: Smooth, buttery mashed potatoes.
steps: Boil peeled, cubed potatoes in salted water until very soft.
Drain well and mash.
Stir in butter and warm milk until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Vegetable Soup
description: Light, healthy soup from everyday vegetables.
steps: Saute garlic, onion and celery until soft.
Add diced carrot and potato and cover with water.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add chopped cabbage, cook 5 more minutes, and season.

name: Garden Salad
description: Crisp lettuce, tomato and cucumber with a simple vinaigrette.
steps: Tear the lettuce and slice the tomato and cucumber.
Whisk vinegar with oil, salt and pepper.
Toss everything together just before serving.

name: Guacamole
description: Chunky avocado dip with tomato, onion and lime.
steps: Mash the avocados, leaving some chunks.
Stir in finely chopped tomato and onion.
Season with lime juice and salt.

name: Filipino Fruit Salad
description: Sweet, creamy dessert of mixed fruit and condensed milk.
steps: Drain the fruit cocktail well.
Mix with cream and condensed milk.
Chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

name: Sinigang na Hipon
description: Sour tamarind soup with shrimp and vegetables.
steps: Boil water with quartered tomato and onion for 5 minutes.
Add the tamarind (or soup mix) and sliced radish. Simmer 5 minutes.
Add string beans, then the shrimp. Cook until the shrimp turn pink.
Add kangkong, turn off the heat, and season with fish sauce or salt.

name: Kare-Kare
description: Beef and vegetables in a rich peanut sauce, served with shrimp paste.
steps: Simmer the beef in water for about 1.5 hours until tender. Keep the broth.
Saute garlic and onion, add the beef and 3 cups of broth.
Stir in peanut butter until the sauce is smooth and thick.
Add eggplant and string beans, cook 5 minutes, then the bok choy.
Serve with shrimp paste on the side.

name: Lumpiang Shanghai
description: Crispy Filipino spring rolls filled with seasoned pork.
steps: Mix ground pork, finely chopped carrot, onion and garlic, egg, salt and pepper.
Spread a thin line of filling on each wrapper and roll tightly. Seal with water.
Cut into bite-size pieces if you like.
Deep-fry until golden and cooked through, about 5 minutes.

name: Arroz Caldo
description: Comforting ginger chicken rice porridge.
steps: Saute garlic, onion and ginger strips. Add the chicken and brown it.
Add uncooked rice and fish sauce and stir for a minute.
Pour in 6 cups of water and simmer 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick.
Top with green onion and toasted garlic.

name: Pork Menudo
description: Pork stew with potato, carrot and bell pepper in tomato sauce.
steps: Saute garlic and onion, then add cubed pork and brown it.
Add soy sauce, tomato sauce and a cup of water. Simmer 30 minutes.
Add diced potato and carrot and cook until tender.
Add bell pepper, cook 2 minutes, and season.

name: Chicken Afritada
description: Chicken braised with potato, carrot and bell pepper in tomato sauce.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in a little oil. Set aside.
Saute garlic and onion, return the chicken, and add tomato sauce and water.
Simmer 20 minutes, then add potato and carrot.
Cook until tender, add bell pepper, and season with salt and pepper.

name: Beef Caldereta
description: Hearty beef stew in a tomato and liver spread sauce.
steps: Brown the beef, then simmer in water for about 1.5 hours until tender.
Saute garlic and onion, add the beef, tomato sauce and some of its broth.
Add potato and carrot and cook until tender.
Stir in liver spread to thicken, add bell pepper, and season.

name: Ginataang Kalabasa at Sitaw
description: Squash and string beans simmered in coconut milk with shrimp.
steps: Saute garlic and onion.
Add coconut milk and cubed squash. Simmer until the squash is almost soft.
Add string beans and shrimp and cook 5 minutes.
Season with salt or fish sauce.

name: Pinakbet
description: Mixed vegetables sauteed with pork and shrimp paste.
steps: Cook sliced pork until it renders some fat and browns.
Add garlic, onion and tomato and cook until soft. Stir in shrimp paste.
Add squash and a little water. Cook 5 minutes.
Add the remaining vegetables and cook until just tender. Avoid over-stirring.

name: Tortang Giniling
description: Ground pork and potato omelette.
steps: Saute garlic and onion, add ground pork and finely diced potato. Cook through.
Let the filling cool slightly, then mix with beaten eggs.
Fry spoonfuls in a pan until set on both sides.

name: Champorado
description: Chocolate rice porridge, often served with milk on top.
steps: Boil the glutinous rice in 5 cups of water, stirring, until soft.
Stir in cocoa and sugar and cook until thick.
Serve hot with a swirl of milk.
image_credit: Photo: Josh James from Imus, Philippines (CC BY 2.0)

name: Leche Flan
description: Silky caramel custard.
steps: Melt sugar in the mold over low heat until amber. Let it set.
Whisk egg yolks with condensed and evaporated milk. Strain the mixture.
Pour into the mold, cover with foil, and steam for 35 to 40 minutes.
Cool, chill, and turn out onto a plate.

name: Turon
description: Crispy fried banana rolls with caramelized sugar.
steps: Slice bananas lengthwise and roll each in brown sugar.
Wrap in spring roll wrappers and seal with water.
Fry until golden, sprinkling extra brown sugar into the oil to caramelize.

name: Ginisang Repolyo
description: Quick sauteed cabbage with pork and carrot.
steps: Saute garlic and onion, then add thinly sliced pork and cook through.
Add carrot strips and cook 2 minutes.
Add the cabbage and stir-fry until just wilted. Season with fish sauce.

name: Tokwa't Baboy
description: Fried tofu and pork in a tangy soy-vinegar sauce.
steps: Boil the pork until tender, then slice. Fry the tofu until golden and cube it.
Mix vinegar, soy sauce, chopped onion and chili.
Pour the sauce over the pork and tofu and toss.

name: Garlic-Vinegar Fried Fish (Daing)
description: Fish marinated in vinegar and garlic, then fried crisp.
steps: Marinate the fish in vinegar, crushed garlic, salt and pepper for at least 30 minutes.
Pat dry and fry until crisp on both sides.
Serve with garlic rice and a vinegar dip.

name: Pancit Bihon
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with chicken and vegetables.
steps: Soak the rice noodles in water for 10 minutes and drain.
Saute garlic and onion, add sliced chicken and cook through.
Add carrot, cabbage, soy sauce and a cup of water. Bring to a boil.
Add the noodles and toss until the liquid is absorbed.

name: Bicol Express
description: Spicy pork stewed in coconut milk with shrimp paste.
steps: Saute garlic and onion, add cubed pork and brown it.
Stir in shrimp paste, then the coconut milk.
Simmer 30 minutes until the pork is tender and the sauce thickens.
Add sliced chilies and cook 5 more minutes.

name: Mango Float
description: No-bake layered dessert of graham crackers, cream and mango.
steps: Whip the cream with condensed milk until thick.
Layer graham crackers, cream and sliced mango in a dish.
Repeat the layers, ending with cream and mango.
Chill for at least 4 hours.

name: Pork Sisig
description: Sizzling chopped pork with onion, chili and calamansi.
steps: Boil the pork until tender, then grill or pan-fry until crisp.
Chop finely and mix with chopped onion, chili and calamansi juice.
Fry the mixture in a hot pan, then stir in a little mayonnaise.
Top with an egg and serve sizzling.

name: Filipino-Style Spaghetti
description: Sweet tomato spaghetti with ground pork, hotdog and cheese.
steps: Cook the pasta and drain.
Saute garlic and onion, add ground pork and sliced hotdogs and cook through.
Add tomato sauce and banana ketchup. Simmer 15 minutes.
Serve the sauce over the pasta and top with grated cheese.

name: Tapsilog
description: Sweet-savory beef tapa with garlic rice and a fried egg.
steps: Marinate thin beef slices in soy sauce, sugar and garlic for at least 30 minutes.
Pan-fry the beef until caramelized.
Fry cooked rice with toasted garlic.
Serve with a fried egg.

name: Hotsilog
description: Hotdogs with garlic rice and a fried egg.
steps: Slit and pan-fry the hotdogs until browned.
Fry cooked rice with toasted garlic.
Fry the eggs and serve everything together.

name: Banana Cue
description: Saba bananas fried and coated in caramelized brown sugar.
steps: Peel the saba bananas.
Fry in hot oil until lightly golden.
Add brown sugar and keep turning until coated in caramel.
Skewer and let cool slightly.

name: Chicken Teriyaki
description: Pan-fried chicken in a glossy sweet soy glaze.
steps: Pan-fry the chicken skin-side down until crisp, then flip and cook through.
Mix soy sauce, sugar, grated ginger and garlic with a splash of water.
Pour into the pan and simmer until it coats the chicken.
Slice and serve over rice.

name: Oyakodon
description: Japanese chicken and egg rice bowl.
steps: Simmer sliced onion in a little water, soy sauce and a pinch of sugar.
Add bite-size chicken and cook through.
Pour beaten eggs over, cover, and cook until just set.
Slide over bowls of rice.

name: Miso Soup
description: Light Japanese soup with tofu and seaweed.
steps: Bring 3 cups of water to a simmer.
Add cubed tofu and seaweed and warm through.
Turn off the heat and whisk in the miso. Do not boil it.
Top with green onion.

name: Upgraded Instant Noodles
description: Instant noodles made into a proper meal with egg and vegetables.
steps: Boil the noodles with sliced cabbage.
Crack in an egg and let it poach for 2 minutes.
Stir in the seasoning and top with green onion.

name: Kimchi Fried Rice
description: Spicy, tangy fried rice topped with a fried egg.
steps: Fry chopped kimchi in a little oil for 2 minutes.
Add cooked rice and a splash of kimchi juice and soy sauce. Stir-fry well.
Top with a fried egg and green onion.

name: Beef Bulgogi
description: Korean sweet soy marinated beef.
steps: Marinate thin beef slices in soy sauce, sugar, garlic and sesame oil for 20 minutes.
Cook over high heat with sliced onion until caramelized.
Top with green onion and serve with rice.

name: Japchae
description: Korean glass noodles stir-fried with beef and vegetables.
steps: Cook the glass noodles, drain, and toss with a little sesame oil.
Stir-fry the beef, then the onion and carrot separately. Blanch the spinach.
Combine everything with soy sauce, a pinch of sugar and sesame oil.
Toss well and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Kra Pao)
description: Spicy stir-fried chicken with holy basil, served with rice and egg.
steps: Pound garlic and chili together.
Stir-fry with minced chicken over high heat until cooked.
Season with soy sauce, fish sauce and a pinch of sugar. Stir in basil.
Serve over rice with a crispy fried egg.

name: Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, egg and peanuts.
steps: Soak the rice noodles until pliable and drain.
Stir-fry tofu and shrimp, push aside, and scramble the egg.
Add noodles with fish sauce, a little sugar and lime juice. Toss until soft.
Add bean sprouts and top with crushed peanuts and lime.

name: Thai Green Curry
description: Fragrant coconut curry with chicken and eggplant.
steps: Fry the curry paste in a little coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until sealed.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk and add eggplant. Simmer 15 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and sugar, and stir in basil.

name: Tom Yum Soup
description: Hot and sour Thai soup with shrimp and mushroom.
steps: Simmer bruised lemongrass in water for 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and chili, then the shrimp.
Cook until the shrimp turn pink.
Off the heat, season with fish sauce and lime juice.

name: Mapo Tofu
description: Silky tofu in a spicy pork and chili bean sauce.
steps: Brown ground pork, then add garlic, ginger and chili bean paste.
Add a cup of water and bring to a simmer.
Gently add cubed tofu and simmer 5 minutes.
Thicken with a little cornstarch slurry and top with green onion.

name: Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry
description: Classic Chinese home dish of soft eggs and saucy tomatoes.
steps: Scramble the eggs until just set and remove.
Stir-fry tomato wedges until they soften into a sauce.
Add a pinch of sugar and salt, return the eggs, and toss.
Top with green onion.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
description: Crispy pork with pineapple and peppers in a tangy sauce.
steps: Coat pork pieces in cornstarch and fry until crisp.
Stir-fry onion and bell pepper briefly.
Add vinegar, ketchup, sugar and pineapple. Thicken with cornstarch slurry.
Toss in the pork and serve right away.

name: Beef and Broccoli
description: Tender beef and broccoli in a garlicky soy sauce.
steps: Toss thin beef slices with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Blanch the broccoli for 1 minute.
Sear the beef over high heat, add garlic and ginger.
Add broccoli and a splash of soy sauce and water. Toss until glossy.

name: Vietnamese Fresh Spring Rolls
description: Rice paper rolls with shrimp, noodles and crisp vegetables.
steps: Cook the shrimp and rice noodles. Slice the vegetables thinly.
Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for a few seconds.
Layer lettuce, noodles, vegetables and shrimp, then roll tightly.
Serve with peanut or fish sauce dip.

name: Dal (Lentil Curry)
description: Warming spiced lentils, great with rice or flatbread.
steps: Simmer the lentils with turmeric in water until soft, about 25 minutes.
Fry cumin, then onion, garlic, ginger and tomato until soft.
Stir into the lentils and simmer 5 minutes. Season with salt.

name: Chana Masala
description: Chickpeas simmered in a spiced tomato and onion sauce.
steps: Fry onion until golden, then add garlic and ginger.
Add chopped tomato and garam masala and cook until saucy.
Add the chickpeas and a little water. Simmer 15 minutes.

name: Butter Chicken
description: Mild, creamy tomato curry with tender chicken.
steps: Brown the chicken in butter and set aside.
Cook garlic, ginger and garam masala in more butter for a minute.
Add tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and the chicken and simmer until cooked through.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Slow-simmered beef and tomato sauce over pasta.
steps: Soften finely chopped onion, carrot and garlic.
Add ground beef and brown it.
Add tomato sauce and simmer for at least 30 minutes.
Serve over cooked pasta.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Pasta in a silky egg and cheese sauce with crispy bacon.
steps: Cook the pasta. Save a cup of the cooking water.
Fry bacon with garlic until crisp.
Mix eggs with grated cheese and lots of black pepper.
Off the heat, toss pasta with bacon, then the egg mixture and a splash of pasta water until creamy.

name: Pesto Pasta
description: Pasta tossed in fresh basil and garlic pesto.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Blend basil, garlic, cheese and olive oil into a paste.
Toss with the pasta and a splash of pasta water.

name: Mac and Cheese
description: Creamy stovetop macaroni and cheese.
steps: Cook the macaroni and drain.
Melt butter, stir in flour, then whisk in milk until thick.
Melt in the cheese and season.
Stir in the macaroni.
image_credit: Photo: Stuart Spivack from Cleveland, Ohio, USA (CC BY-SA 2.0)

name: Chicken Alfredo
description: Pasta and chicken in a rich garlic cream sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta. Pan-fry seasoned chicken and slice it.
Melt butter, cook garlic briefly, then add cream and simmer.
Stir in cheese until smooth.
Toss with pasta and top with chicken.

name: Homemade Cheeseburger
description: Juicy beef patties with cheese and fresh toppings.
steps: Shape ground beef into patties and season with salt and pepper.
Cook in a hot pan 3 to 4 minutes per side. Add cheese at the end to melt.
Toast the buns.
Build with lettuce, tomato and onion.

name: Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
description: Tender beef meatballs simmered in tomato sauce.
steps: Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, chopped onion and garlic. Season.
Roll into balls and brown them in a pan.
Add tomato sauce and simmer 20 minutes.
Serve with pasta, rice or bread.
image_credit: Photo: Juan Emilio Prades Bel (CC BY 4.0)

name: Shepherd's Pie
description: Savory beef and vegetables under a mashed potato crust.
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk.
Brown ground beef with onion and carrot, add peas and a little water, and simmer.
Spread the beef in a baking dish and cover with mash.
Bake at 200 C for 25 minutes until golden.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Classic, soothing soup with chicken and vegetables.
steps: Simmer the chicken with onion, carrot and celery in water for 25 minutes.
Remove the chicken and shred it.
Add noodles to the pot and cook until tender.
Return the chicken and season.

name: Creamy Tomato Soup
description: Smooth tomato soup, perfect with grilled cheese.
steps: Soften onion and garlic in butter.
Add chopped tomatoes and a cup of water. Simmer 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, stir in cream, and season.

name: Minestrone
description: Italian vegetable soup with beans and pasta.
steps: Soften onion, carrot and celery.
Add chopped tomato and water and simmer 15 minutes.
Add zucchini, beans and small pasta and cook until the pasta is tender.
Season and serve with cheese if you have it.
image_credit: Photo: Katrin Morenz from Aachen, Deutschland (CC BY-SA 2.0)

name: Potato Salad
description: Creamy potato salad with egg and celery.
steps: Boil cubed potatoes until tender and hard-boil the eggs.
Chop the eggs, onion and celery.
Mix everything with mayonnaise, salt and pepper. Chill before serving.

name: Coleslaw
description: Crunchy cabbage and carrot salad in a creamy dressing.
steps: Finely shred the cabbage and carrot.
Mix mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar and salt.
Toss together and chill for 30 minutes.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
description: Toasted tortillas filled with chicken, cheese and peppers.
steps: Cook sliced chicken with onion and bell pepper.
Fill a tortilla with the mixture and cheese, and fold.
Toast in a dry pan until crisp and the cheese melts. Cut into wedges.

name: Beef Tacos
description: Seasoned ground beef in tortillas with fresh toppings.
steps: Brown ground beef with chopped onion. Season with salt, pepper and any spices you have.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, lettuce, tomato and cheese.

name: Chili con Carne
description: Hearty beef and bean stew with chili.
steps: Brown ground beef with onion and garlic.
Stir in chili powder, then add chopped tomato and beans.
Simmer 40 minutes, stirring now and then. Season to taste.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Juicy shrimp in a lemony garlic butter sauce.
steps: Melt butter and cook minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2 minutes per side.
Finish with lemon juice and serve with rice or bread.

name: Lemon Garlic Baked Salmon
description: Simple oven-baked salmon with lemon and garlic butter.
steps: Place the salmon on a tray and season with salt and pepper.
Top with melted butter, garlic and lemon slices.
Bake at 200 C for 12 to 15 minutes until it flakes easily.

name: Roast Chicken with Vegetables
description: One-tray roast chicken with potato and carrot.
steps: Rub the chicken with butter, garlic, salt and pepper.
Surround with chunks of potato, carrot and onion.
Roast at 200 C for about 1 hour 15 minutes until the juices run clear.
Rest 10 minutes before carving.

name: Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Apple
description: Golden pork chops with buttery sauteed apple and onion.
steps: Season the pork chops and sear until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook sliced onion and apple in butter until soft.
Spoon over the pork chops.

name: Ratatouille
description: Provencal stew of summer vegetables.
steps: Cube all the vegetables.
Soften onion and garlic, then add bell pepper and eggplant and cook 10 minutes.
Add zucchini and tomato and simmer 30 minutes until soft and saucy.
Season and serve warm or cold.

name: Fluffy Pancakes
description: Classic fluffy breakfast pancakes.
steps: Whisk flour, sugar and baking powder.
Whisk in milk, egg and melted butter until just combined.
Cook ladlefuls on a hot greased pan until bubbles form, then flip.

name: Avocado Toast with Egg
description: Toast topped with mashed avocado and a fried egg.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper and spread on the toast.
Top with a fried or poached egg.

name: Breakfast Burrito
description: Tortilla wrapped around eggs, potato, bacon and cheese.
steps: Fry diced potato until crisp and cook the bacon.
Scramble the eggs.
Fill tortillas with potato, bacon, egg and cheese, and roll up.
image_credit: Photo: Cajsa Lilliehook from Portland (CC BY-SA 2.0)

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Soften onion, bell pepper and garlic. Add cumin.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer until thick, about 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook until the whites set.
Serve with bread.

name: Overnight Oats
description: No-cook oats soaked overnight with yogurt and banana.
steps: Mix oats, milk, yogurt and honey in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with sliced banana in the morning.

name: Banana Smoothie
description: Creamy banana and yogurt smoothie.
steps: Blend banana, milk, yogurt and honey until smooth.
Add ice if you like it cold and thick.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
description: A single-serving chocolate cake made in the microwave.
steps: Mix flour, cocoa and sugar in a large mug.
Stir in milk, egg and melted butter until smooth.
Microwave on high for 70 to 90 seconds.

name: Banana Bread
description: Moist loaf made with overripe bananas.
steps: Mash the bananas and mix in melted butter, sugar and egg.
Stir in flour and baking soda until just combined.
Pour into a loaf pan and bake at 175 C for about 55 minutes.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Chewy cookies loaded with chocolate chips.
steps: Cream butter with both sugars, then beat in the egg.
Mix in flour and baking soda, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop onto a tray and bake at 180 C for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Thai dessert of sweet coconut sticky rice with ripe mango.
steps: Soak the glutinous rice for at least 1 hour, then steam until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and a pinch of salt.
Stir most of it into the rice and let it absorb for 15 minutes.
Serve with sliced mango and the remaining sauce.

name: Apple Crumble
description: Warm baked apples under a buttery oat topping.
steps: Slice the apples into a baking dish and toss with a little sugar.
Rub butter into flour, oats and sugar until crumbly.
Scatter over the apples and bake at 180 C for 30 minutes.

name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: Crispy tofu with colorful vegetables in soy-garlic sauce.
steps: Fry cubed tofu until golden. Set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, broccoli, carrot and bell pepper for 3 minutes.
Return the tofu, add soy sauce, and toss.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy rice slowly cooked with mushrooms and cheese.
steps: Cook mushrooms in butter until browned. Set aside.
Soften onion and garlic, add the rice, and stir for a minute.
Add warm broth a ladle at a time, stirring, until the rice is creamy, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the mushrooms, cheese and a knob of butter.

name: Egg Drop Soup
description: Silky Chinese soup with ribbons of egg.
steps: Bring the broth to a simmer and thicken lightly with cornstarch slurry.
Slowly pour in beaten egg while stirring gently.
Season and top with green onion.

name: Garlic Bread
description: Crisp bread with garlic butter.
steps: Mix soft butter with minced garlic and a pinch of salt.
Spread on sliced bread.
Toast in the oven or a pan until golden and crisp.

name: Hummus
description: Smooth chickpea dip with garlic and lemon.
steps: Blend chickpeas with garlic, lemon juice and a splash of water.
Drizzle in olive oil while blending until smooth.
Season with salt and serve with bread or vegetables.

name: Corn and Egg Soup
description: Quick, comforting corn soup with egg.
steps: Soften onion, then add the corn and broth. Simmer 10 minutes.
Slowly stir in beaten egg.
Season with salt and pepper.
